summaries.summary: Influencers Logan and Jake Paul visited the Pentagon, meeting with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and addressing troops.
points: The Paul brothers also met with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent during their visit.
The visit occurred amid efforts to promote martial arts and physical fitness among service members.
Celebrities have visited the Pentagon in previous administrations, including Milo Ventimiglia and Gerard Butler.
summaries.significance: The Paul brothers' visit to the Pentagon follows a trend of celebrity engagements with military officials, aiming to promote martial arts and fitness among service members.

summaries.summary: Morocco's parliamentary elections are influenced by youth unemployment, football, and anti-Israel sentiment.
points: 60,000 people attempted to cross to Ceuta, highlighting economic struggles.
Fouzi Lekjaa, football federation president, campaigns using football slogans.
Justice and Development Party promises to end ties with Israel, citing normalization as a mistake.

summaries.summary: New GPT-6 Sol and Luna models offer cost-efficient, advanced AI capabilities for various professional tasks.
points: GPT-6 Sol outperforms Claude Opus 5 at 9% of its cost per task in business workflows.
GPT-6 Luna improves on its predecessor by 5.4 percentage points at 58% lower cost.
GPT-6 Sol matches Claude Fable 5.1 at about 1% of its cost on factuality evaluations.
